messages.subject: Whitmore — potential tribunal claim
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We've received a letter from Ashworth Quinn LLP acting for Dr Rebecca Whitmore, our former Clinical Governance Lead at Ferndene Court. They're threatening an automatic unfair dismissal / whistleblowing claim off the back of the East Region restructuring. Given the CQC sensitivities you know about, we'd like Whitfield Carter to take this on.

Can you take instructions and send across an engagement letter? Lorna ran the process and can give you the background.

Daniel Pryce
General Counsel & Company Secretary
Ashbourne Healthcare Group Limited

messages.subject: RE: Whitmore — potential tribunal claim
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Happy to act. Our engagement letter is attached — please sign and return the copy. Elena Marchetti will run this day to day with Tom Gallagher supporting; I'll supervise.

Could Lorna forward the redundancy consultation papers and Dr Whitmore's grievance file so we can assess merits quickly? We should get ahead of the ACAS early conciliation clock.

Best,
Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
